    Which "FIT" is Right For You?

    Impact Custom Mouthguards offers two distinct options for athletes: the CustomFIT and QuickFIT mouthguards. The CustomFIT mouthguard is tailored to each individual's dental profile, ensuring optimal protection and comfort. In contrast, the QuickFIT mouthguard provides a faster and more convenient solution, offering a great fit with less customization.
